How many shares must the hedge hold? Positions may be fractional.
instances.spoken_text: A stock will end at fourteen or twenty-eight. You want to replicate a two-outcome contingent payment paying twenty-two in the low state and thirty-four in the high state, using shares plus a bank holding whose terminal value is the same in both states. How many shares must the hedge hold? Positions may be fractional.

follow_up.question: Can you determine the initial total cost from only these terminal data?
follow_up.reference: The share count is determined by the difference in terminal payoffs divided by the difference in stock values. An initial cost additionally needs the current stock price and the price of the bank payoff.
